note: Lafayette County (FL) publishes its zoning only as a PDF Zoning Atlas (LAZN8.pdf); the county's planning page links no ArcGIS REST or GIS zoning service. Mayo, the only incorporated town, publishes its Official Zoning Atlas only as a PDF (MAYZN10.pdf, 1992). Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub and the web found no queryable zoning district layer for the county or Mayo; the only zoning-like sources are third-party (zoneomics) and paid parcel products.
